text: Can you tell me about your sleep lately, and whether you've noticed any vaginal dryness as well?
Do you drink wine or other alcohol, and have you noticed it brings on the hot flashes?
Has your mood or temper changed recently, and how has that affected things with your husband?
Are your periods still coming regularly, or have they pretty much stopped?
Do you find it burns or stings when you pee, or that you have to go more often?
Have you noticed things feeling dry or uncomfortable down there during sex, even with lubricant?
Have you experienced any dyspareunia with intercourse?
Any episodes of palpitations or diaphoresis accompanying the flashes?
Have you ever had menorrhagia or intermenstrual bleeding in the past?
Have you had a bone density scan, or DEXA, done at any point?
What has your blood pressure been running at home, do you check it?
When was your last mammogram, and was it normal?
Is there anything else about how you've been feeling that you'd like to tell me?
Tell me more about how all of this has been affecting your day to day life.
What else is going on that you think might be important for me to know?
Have you had any sexually transmitted infections in the past?
Are you up to date on your vaccinations, like your flu shot?
Do you take any regular medications, prescription or over the counter, including vitamins?
You mentioned these are happening almost every day now, how sure are you that they've actually gotten more frequent over time?
Earlier you said it starts in your chest, can you walk me through exactly how it spreads from there?
You said this hasn't really changed your life, but it sounds like it's bothering you quite a bit at work, can you tell me more about that?
